title: Episode 87: Reddit Trending — Did Donald Trump Receive a Mandate for Sweeping Change in 2024?
itunes_title: Reddit Trending — Did Donald Trump Receive a Mandate for Sweeping Change in 2024?
description:
**Top Trending Friday** — our weekly pick of the top-trending paper on r/science this week.

**[Did Donald Trump Receive a Mandate for Sweeping Change in 2024?](https://doi.org/10.1017/S1049096525101868)**

*PS: Political Science & Politics, 2025*

DOI: [10.1017/S1049096525101868](https://doi.org/10.1017/S1049096525101868)

**Question:** Did Trump's 2024 victory and subsequent polling give him a genuine public mandate for the sweeping changes he and his team claimed?

**Answer:** No, by the author's criteria. Trump won 49.8% of the vote, a smaller share than 40 of the prior 50 presidential winners, and polls show the public opposed most of his major policy actions.

**Three takeaways**

1. Trump's margin over Harris was ~1.5 points; he ranks in the bottom fifth of popular-vote winners historically.
2. Support for deporting undocumented immigrants ranged from 97% (violent criminals) to 5% (married to a citizen), and fell 14 points once consequences were named.
3. Many actions taken (Greenland, USAID cuts, NIH firings) were never mentioned during the campaign, weakening any mandate claim for them.

source_metadata.title: Did Donald Trump Receive a Mandate for Sweeping Change in 2024?
source_metadata.abstract:
ABSTRACT
                  Donald Trump and his supporters claimed an historic mandate to provide critical legitimacy for the extraordinary changes the president initiated immediately after taking office. Did he actually receive such a mandate? The data show that he did not. His electoral victory was modest by historical standards, and the public did not view his election as a mandate for sweeping change and did not desire to accord the president additional power. Moreover, Trump did not campaign on many of the issues on which he took action, and the public opposed most of the president’s major changes in policy. These actions included drastically cutting or dismembering congressionally authorized agencies and programs, deporting most undocumented aliens, raising tariffs, and gutting foreign aid.
